business_problem: Teladoc Health needed to replace spreadsheet-driven financial reporting and reconciliation across global operating units with a centralized, secure analytics platform that could unify data from Oracle and third-party systems and deliver trusted KPIs without manual preparation.
solution_summary: After deploying Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM, Teladoc added Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence as a centralized analytics and data management layer tied directly to its systems of record. Prebuilt data pipelines ingest finance data from payables, receivables, general ledger, procurement, and selected third-party applications into a secure, auditable repository, where prebuilt dashboards and more than 80% of the KPIs the team needed were available out of the box. The platform gives accounts payable teams visibility into balances and invoice aging, automates metrics such as payment days and on-time performance, and removes the need for manual spreadsheet reconciliation and executive presentation preparation. Because Fusion Data Intelligence sits close to existing Oracle Fusion Applications, Teladoc can extend the same data foundation into planned anomaly detection, supplier performance monitoring, and customer risk analysis.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence
solution_components.role: Acts as the centralized, secure analytics repository with prebuilt pipelines, KPIs, dashboards, and analyses.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
solution_components.role: Supplies core financial transaction data from operational finance processes into the analytics environment.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud EPM
solution_components.role: Provides planning and performance-management data that complements transactional finance reporting.

data_flow: Finance data from Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle Fusion EPM, and selected third-party applications flows through prebuilt Fusion Data Intelligence pipelines into a centralized repository, where KPIs and dashboards surface AP, AR, general ledger, procurement, spend, and cashflow insights for finance teams and executives.
business_outcome: Teladoc eliminated manual spreadsheet maintenance and reconciliation, gained a secure auditable finance repository, and accelerated reporting and decision-making with prebuilt KPIs and dashboards that now support both current financial operations and planned AI-driven anomaly detection and risk analysis.
metrics: More than 80% of required KPIs were available out of the box
